description: Groove-local superposition of the experimental ARHGAP21 PDZ NMR structure and the ARHGAP23 AlphaFold model onto PSD-95 PDZ3, with CRIPT peptide transfer
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse_pdb(txt,model=1):
    out=[];cur=1
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("MODEL"): cur=int(l.split()[1])
        if l.startswith("ATOM") and cur==model:
            out.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],resi=int(l[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),b=float(l[60:66] or 0)))
    return out
def chain_seq(at,ch):
    s={}
    for a in at:
        if a["ch"]==ch and a["resn"] in AA3: s.setdefault(a["resi"],AA3[a["resn"]])
    k=sorted(s); return "".join(s[i] for i in k),k
def ca(at,ch): return {a["resi"]:a["xyz"] for a in at if a["ch"]==ch and a["name"]=="CA"}
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T;return R,qc-R@pc
def rmsd(P,Q,R,t): return float(np.sqrt((((P@R.T+t)-Q)**2).sum(1).mean()))

t95=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1BE9.pdb",timeout=90).text
t21=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2YUY.pdb",timeout=90).text
taf=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9P227-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
P95=parse_pdb(t95);A21=parse_pdb(t21,1);AF=parse_pdb(taf)
c95,c21,caf=ca(P95,"A"),ca(A21,"A"),ca(AF,"A")
pep=[a for a in P95 if a["ch"]=="B"]; pk=sorted({a["resi"] for a in pep})

# ---- CORRESPONDENCES established earlier by sequence alignment (3 independent methods agreed) ----
# PSD-95 PDZ3 -> ARHGAP21 (2YUY construct numbering) -> ARHGAP23 (UniProt numbering)
# GPhiGPhi : G322/L323/G324/F325  -> G20/F21/G22/F23   -> G53/F54/G55/F56
# betaB    : 326-331              -> 24-29             -> 57-62
# alphaB   : 371-382              -> 97-108            -> 132-143
GROOVE=[(322,331,20,29,53,62),(371,382,97,108,132,143)]   # (p_s,p_e, a21_s,a21_e, a23_s,a23_e)
def groove_pairs(coordsT, idx):
    P,Q,lab=[],[],[]
    for ps,pe,*rest in GROOVE:
        ts,te=rest[idx*2],rest[idx*2+1]
        for o in range(pe-ps+1):
            a,b=ps+o,ts+o
            if a in c95 and b in coordsT: P.append(c95[a]);Q.append(coordsT[b]);lab.append((a,b))
    return np.array(P),np.array(Q),lab

print("="*80)
print("LOCAL GROOVE SUPERPOSITION (GPhiGPhi loop + betaB + alphaB only)")
print("="*80)
res={}
for nm,crd,idx in [("ARHGAP21 PDZ, PDB 2YUY (NMR, experimental)",c21,0),
                   ("ARHGAP23 PDZ, AlphaFold DB v6 (model)",caf,1)]:
    P,Q,lab=groove_pairs(crd,idx); R,t=kabsch(P,Q); r=rmsd(P,Q,R,t)
    res[nm]=(R,t,r,len(P),crd)
    print(f"  {nm}\n      CA RMSD = {r:.2f} A over {len(P)} groove-lining positions")

print("\n"+"="*80)
print("PER-REGION FIT and CRIPT PEPTIDE TRANSFER")
print("="*80)
summary=[]
for nm,(R,t,r,n,crd) in res.items():
    atoms=[a for a in (A21 if "2YUY" in nm else AF) if a["ch"]=="A"]
    if "AlphaFold" in nm: atoms=[a for a in atoms if 41<=a["resi"]<=165]
    lig=[dict(a,xyz=a["xyz"]@R.T+t) for a in pep]
    bb={"N","CA","C","O"}
    nbb=sum(1 for L in lig if L["name"] in bb for A in atoms if A["name"] in bb and np.linalg.norm(L["xyz"]-A["xyz"])<3.0)
    nall=sum(1 for L in lig for A in atoms if np.linalg.norm(L["xyz"]-A["xyz"])<2.2)
    mind=min(np.linalg.norm(L["xyz"]-A["xyz"]) for L in lig if L["name"] in bb for A in atoms if A["name"] in bb)
    print(f"\n{nm}")
    print(f"  backbone-backbone clashes <3.0 A : {nbb}   closest bb-bb contact {mind:.2f} A")
    for pres in pk:
        la=[a for a in lig if a["resi"]==pres]
        lb={pk[-1]:"P0",pk[-2]:"P-1",pk[-3]:"P-2",pk[-4]:"P-3",pk[-5]:"P-4"}[pres]
        near={}
        for L in la:
            for A in atoms:
                d=np.linalg.norm(L["xyz"]-A["xyz"])
                if d<4.2:
                    k=f"{A['resn']}{A['resi']}"
                    if k not in near or d<near[k]: near[k]=d
        print(f"    {lb:4s} {AA3[la[0]['resn']]}  "+"; ".join(f"{k} {v:.1f}" for k,v in sorted(near.items(),key=lambda x:x[1])[:5]))
    # P-2 hydroxyl geometry
    og1=[a["xyz"] for a in pep if a["resi"]==pk[-3] and a["name"]=="OG1"][0]@R.T+t
    ab1 = 98 if "2YUY" in nm else 133
    oh=[a["xyz"] for a in atoms if a["resi"]==ab1 and a["name"]=="OH"]
    d_oh=np.linalg.norm(oh[0]-og1) if oh else np.nan
    summary.append((nm,r,nbb,d_oh)); print(f"    alphaB1 Tyr{ab1} OH ... P-2 Thr OG1 = {d_oh:.2f} A")

og1n=[a["xyz"] for a in pep if a["resi"]==pk[-3] and a["name"]=="OG1"][0]
ne2=[a["xyz"] for a in P95 if a["ch"]=="A" and a["resi"]==372 and a["name"]=="NE2"][0]
print(f"\nREFERENCE  PSD-95 His372 NE2 ... P-2 Thr OG1 = {np.linalg.norm(ne2-og1n):.2f} A (crystallographic, class I)")

# ---- is the AlphaFold ARHGAP23 model corroborated by the experimental paralog structure? ----
print("\n"+"="*80); print("AlphaFold ARHGAP23 model vs experimental ARHGAP21 NMR structure")
P,Q=[],[]
for a23,a21 in [(53+i,20+i) for i in range(10)]+[(132+i,97+i) for i in range(12)]+[(117,84),(118,85)]:
    if a23 in caf and a21 in c21: P.append(caf[a23]);Q.append(c21[a21])
P,Q=np.array(P),np.array(Q); R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
print(f"  groove-core CA RMSD = {rmsd(P,Q,R,t):.2f} A over {len(P)} positions")
print(f"  ARHGAP23 Tyr133 CA sits {np.linalg.norm((caf[133]@R.T+t)-c21[98]):.2f} A from ARHGAP21 Tyr98 CA (experimental)")

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6))
lbl=["PSD-95 PDZ3\nHis372 NE2\n(crystal, class I)","ARHGAP21 PDZ\nTyr98 OH\n(NMR 2YUY)","ARHGAP23 PDZ\nTyr133 OH\n(AlphaFold v6)"]
val=[np.linalg.norm(ne2-og1n),summary[0][3],summary[1][3]]
col=["#4C72B0","#C44E52","#DD8452"]
ax[0].bar(lbl,val,color=col); ax[0].axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="grey")
ax[0].text(2.45,3.6,"H-bond cutoff 3.5 A",ha="right",fontsize=8,color="grey")
for i,v in enumerate(val): ax[0].text(i,v+0.08,f"{v:.2f} A",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel("distance to modelled P-2 Thr OG1 (A)"); ax[0].set_ylim(0,4.4)
ax[0].set_title("The alphaB1 side chain reaches the P-2 hydroxyl\nin both ARHGAP21 and ARHGAP23",fontsize=10)
nm2=["ARHGAP21 PDZ\n2YUY (experimental)","ARHGAP23 PDZ\nAlphaFold v6 (model)"]
ax[1].bar(nm2,[summary[0][2],summary[1][2]],color=["#C44E52","#DD8452"])
for i,v in enumerate([summary[0][2],summary[1][2]]): ax[1].text(i,v+0.05,str(v),ha="center")
ax[1].set_ylabel("backbone-backbone clashes < 3.0 A"); ax[1].set_ylim(0,max(2,summary[0][2]+1))
ax[1].set_title("Transferred CRIPT peptide meets no backbone obstruction\nin either structure",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
